templates.lead: A calm frame for your content. Everything stays movable and editable.
templates.loadError: Templates are currently unavailable. You can start with a blank board.
templates.editableHint: The template includes editable notes, coloured zones, headings and a subtle sticker.

tour.title: Give your board a starting point
tour.introduction: Templates give you a ready-made, freely editable layout. Would you like a quick tour?
tour.chooseText: Pick a template or start blank. The preview shows zones and pins. You can freely change colours, text and decorations later.
tour.nameText: Give the board a name. Creating it adds real notes and zones that you can move, extend or delete.

copyTour.title: Reuse good ideas
copyTour.introduction: You can duplicate whole boards or copy individual pins between boards. Would you like to see how?
copyTour.duplicateTitle: Take a whole board with you
copyTour.duplicateText: Duplicate creates a private copy with pins, stacks, connectors, colours and decorations. You choose a new name.
copyTour.pinText: Open a pin and choose Copy or Duplicate. To copy between boards, open the destination board and choose Paste. Ctrl/⌘+C and Ctrl/⌘+V work too, as long as you are not editing text.

portability.scope: Export boards you own, including private skill boards. Boards you only joined are excluded.
portability.premiumLimits: Premium: up to 10,000 CSV rows per import and repeated exports. Account archives include images, limited to 64 MB of image data.
portability.freeLimits: Free: up to 100 CSV rows per import and one JSON export per UTC calendar day.
portability.noBoard: Create a board that allows link pins or ask for editing access first.
